qwen21_1024.source: derived: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=32, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=1; vae/config.json scale_factor_spatial=16. 1024x1024 -> (1024/16)^2 = 4096 image tokens. Single-stream DiT with block-causal mask and prefix KV cache (diffusers transformer_qwenimage21.py): the dominant per-step call is target-image queries over [text prefix + image] keys, so Sq=4096, Sk=4096+31=4127. Text = 31 tokens (model-card example prompt, 23 prompt tokens + 8 user/assistant template tokens after the system prefix is dropped, measured with the repo tokenizer); first step also has a 31-token causal text prefill call.

qwen21_1328.source: derived: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=32, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=1; vae/config.json scale_factor_spatial=16. 1328 is rounded down to 1312 by the pipeline (multiple of vae_scale_factor*2=32), 1312x1312 -> (1312/16)^2 = 6724 image tokens. Single-stream DiT with block-causal mask and prefix KV cache (diffusers transformer_qwenimage21.py): the dominant per-step call is target-image queries over [text prefix + image] keys, so Sq=6724, Sk=6724+31=6755. Text = 31 tokens (model-card example prompt, 23 prompt tokens + 8 user/assistant template tokens after the system prefix is dropped, measured with the repo tokenizer); first step also has a 31-token causal text prefill call.

qwen21_2048.source: derived: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=32, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=1; vae/config.json scale_factor_spatial=16. 2048x2048 -> (2048/16)^2 = 16384 image tokens. Single-stream DiT with block-causal mask and prefix KV cache (diffusers transformer_qwenimage21.py): the dominant per-step call is target-image queries over [text prefix + image] keys, so Sq=16384, Sk=16384+31=16415. Text = 31 tokens (model-card example prompt, 23 prompt tokens + 8 user/assistant template tokens after the system prefix is dropped, measured with the repo tokenizer); first step also has a 31-token causal text prefill call. 2048x2048 is the model card's native 1:1 size (extra entry).

ltx25_480p.source: derived: Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=32, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=1, patch_size_t=1; vae/config.json spatial_compression_ratio=32, temporal_compression_ratio=8. 832x480x121f (pipeline default num_frames=121 @24fps; 480p as 832x480) -> 15x26x16 = 6240 video tokens (attn1 video self-attn). Text is cross-attention (attn2), not joined.

ltx25_720p.source: derived: Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=32, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=1, patch_size_t=1; vae/config.json spatial_compression_ratio=32, temporal_compression_ratio=8. 1280x704x121f (pipeline default num_frames=121 @24fps; 720 not divisible by 32 so 704) -> 22x40x16 = 14080 video tokens (attn1 video self-attn). Text is cross-attention (attn2), not joined.

ltx25_audio_5s.source: derived: Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers transformer/config.json audio_num_attention_heads=32, audio_attention_head_dim=64, audio_patch_size=1; audio_vae/config.json sample_rate=16000, mel_hop_length=160, temporal downsample 4 -> 25 latents/s; 121f/24fps = 5.04 s -> round(5.04*25) = 126 audio tokens (audio_attn1 self-attn, independent of video resolution). Audio-video cross-attn (audio_to_video_attn / video_to_audio_attn, 32x64) has Sq!=Sk and is not listed.

h3v_480p_5s.source: derived: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=56, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=[1,2,2]; vae/config.json spatial_downsample_factors prod=16, temporal_downsample_factors prod=4. 832x480 x 124 frames (5 s @24fps snapped to 17n+5, same frame count as h3_video_5s) -> 15x26x31 = 12090 video tokens. Same convention as rc h3_video_5s: text/audio rows of the packed sequence not included.

wan22_5b_480p.source: derived: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=24, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=[1,2,2]; vae/config.json scale_factor_spatial=16, scale_factor_temporal=4. 832x480x121f (5B default 121 frames @24fps; 480p not an official 5B size) -> 15x26x31 = 12090. Text is cross-attention, not joined.

wan22_5b_720p.source: derived: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers transformer/config.json num_attention_heads=24, attention_head_dim=128, patch_size=[1,2,2]; vae/config.json scale_factor_spatial=16, scale_factor_temporal=4. 1280x704x121f (5B default 121 frames @24fps; official 720p size 1280x704) -> 22x40x31 = 27280. Text is cross-attention, not joined.

zimage_1024.source: derived: Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image transformer/config.json dim=3840, n_heads=30 -> head dim 3840/30=128, all_patch_size=[2]; vae/config.json AutoencoderKL 4 blocks -> 8x. 1024x1024 -> (1024/16)^2 = 4096 image tokens + caption padded to SEQ_MULTI_OF=32 (31-token model-card-style prompt incl. chat template -> 32) = 4128, single-stream joint attention in the 30 main layers (2 noise-refiner layers are image-only 4096). Resolution up to 2048 per model card.

zimage_2048.source: derived: Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image transformer/config.json dim=3840, n_heads=30 -> head dim 3840/30=128, all_patch_size=[2]; vae/config.json AutoencoderKL 4 blocks -> 8x. 2048x2048 -> (2048/16)^2 = 16384 image tokens + caption padded to SEQ_MULTI_OF=32 (31-token model-card-style prompt incl. chat template -> 32) = 16416, single-stream joint attention in the 30 main layers (2 noise-refiner layers are image-only 16384). Resolution up to 2048 per model card.
